request.text: I need the exact Dell P2422H, but it must display native 3840 x 2160. Can I get it new, delivered to Beirut?

message:
No—the Dell P2422H has a native resolution of 1920 × 1080 (Full HD), not 3840 × 2160. A native-4K P2422H does not exist, regardless of condition or seller.
The closest verified Dell alternative is the 27-inch S2722QC at JAK Computer for $390.00, but it is out of stock and its condition is not stated.
JAK adds 11% VAT at checkout; delivery charges depend on the exact Lebanese address and are also added at checkout.
I couldn’t confirm a new, available Dell 4K alternative for delivery to Beirut. If native 4K is essential, choose a different model rather than the P2422H.

product.title: Dell  Monitor S2722QC
product.description:
Dell S2722QC Monitor:
The Dell Monitor S2722QC is a 27-inch 4K UHD monitor designed for users who appreciate sharp visuals, accurate colors, and convenient connectivity. It's a versatile display suitable for a wide range of tasks, from productivity and content creation to multimedia entertainment.
This monitor features a 27-inch IPS panel with a 4K UHD resolution (3840x2160). This high resolution delivers incredibly sharp and detailed images, making it ideal for tasks that demand precision and clarity, such as photo and video editing, graphic design, and working with detailed spreadsheets. The IPS panel technology ensures accurate color reproduction and wide viewing angles of 178 degrees, both horizontally and vertically. This means that colors look consistent and vibrant even when viewed from off-center positions.
A key feature of the S2722QC is its USB-C connectivity, which simplifies your workspace by providing a single-cable solution for video, data, and power delivery (up to 65W) to compatible laptops. This reduces cable clutter and makes it easy to connect and disconnect your laptop. The monitor also includes two HDMI 2.0 ports and one DisplayPort 1.2 port for connecting other devices.
The S2722QC also supports AMD FreeSync technology, which synchronizes the monitor's refresh rate with the frame rate of compatible AMD graphics cards to reduce screen tearing and stuttering during gameplay. This makes it a decent option for casual gaming.
